sections.heading: C2 — Confusables and KG hints
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Additional Safety Tips

FACT_ID: sec14-R01 | anchor: A01
Every seat buckles, small children ride in car seats, and skipped belts cost drivers most for young riders [A01].
Why it matters: group belt-rules; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec14-F02, sec14-F03, sec14-F04 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec14-R02 | anchor: A02
Open beds, towed boats, and towed trailers each bar young or all riders, with parades and emergencies excusing most cases [A02].
Why it matters: group rider-location; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec14-F04, sec14-F05, sec14-F06 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec14-R03 | anchor: A02
Stops park right and dark, hands stay on the wheel, and papers wait for permission [A02].
Why it matters: group stop-conduct; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec14-F07, sec14-F08, sec14-F10 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec14-R04 | anchor: A02
Emergency lights demand instant halts, yet scary spots allow hazard-lit crawls to safety [A02].
Why it matters: group emergency-stop; difficulty medium; prereq sec14-F07; confusables sec14-F09 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec14-R05 | anchor: A03
Silence stays free, licenses stay mandatory, and searches need consent unless cause exists [A03].
Why it matters: group stop-rights; difficulty medium; prereq sec14-F08; confusables sec14-F11, sec14-F12 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec14-R06 | anchor: A03
Signed tickets promise court dates rather than guilt, and grievances travel upward after the stop [A03].
Why it matters: group citations; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec14-F13 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec14-R07 | anchor: A03
Lies to officers, flight from officers, and rage at drivers each escalate penalties [A03].
Why it matters: group offenses; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec14-F14, sec14-F15 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec14-R08 | anchor: A04
Neighborhood electrics, scooters, and balancing devices each cap speed and street access differently [A04].
Why it matters: group small-vehicles; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec14-F16, sec14-F17, sec14-F18, sec14-F19 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec14-R09 | anchor: A05
Loads stay boxed and tarped, trailers stay chained, and tow bars stay short and flagged [A05].
Why it matters: group hauling; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec14-F21, sec14-F22, sec14-F23 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0074]

FACT_ID: sec14-R10 | anchor: A05
Silent exhaust gas forbids indoor idling and broken mufflers, and victims need fresh air fast [A05].
Why it matters: group carbon-monoxide; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec14-F24 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0074]

FACT_ID: sec14-R11 | anchor: A06
Communication barriers earn optional license and registration flags that warn officers early [A06].
Why it matters: group disability-program; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec14-F25 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0075]
